text:
Predicates:
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Premises:
Symphony9 is a music piece.
Composer(x, y) ::: x writes music y.
Beethoven is a composer of Symphony9.
ViennaMusicSociety is an orchestra.
ViennaMusicSociety premiered Symphony9.
Beethoven leads ViennaMusicSociety.
Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conductor(y) ∧ Leads(y, x)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
¬Conductor(Beethoven) ::: Beethoven is not a conductor.
